text:
sam_fin: Noticing a recurring nightly GPU job that was unintentionally tagged `team=research-temp` for August. Rough tally = $15,760. Proposal: retro split 55/35/10 (Platform/Search/Infra) for internal chargebacks and hold any customer credits until vendor reconciliation.

violet_ops: Can you drop the instance sample? I want to confirm scope before running any backfill.

sam_fin: Uploaded full export: gs://billing-backfills/2024-08-research-temp-untagged.csv. Sample rows below. We also flagged two clusters where the label mutation failed.

Sample:
```
instance_id,usage_hours,orig_label,desired_split
athena-gpu-11,72.0,research-temp,platform:0.55;search:0.35;infra:0.10
batch-gpu-77,9.5,research-temp,platform:0.55;search:0.35;infra:0.10
```

owen_platform: Quick root cause: a deploy removed the label sync job for ~36h on 2024-08-11. We reinstated it but historical ingest didn't remap older rows. I recommend ops reprocess with a transform that applies the split and tags ledger as `provisional_internal`.

meera_search: Product ok with 35% provisionally. We need an incident tag and a rollback plan if vendor issues a credit. Also confirm no external customers billed off these runs.

sam_fin: Customer impact check = $0 (internal infra-only). Finance suggests moving forward with reallocation and ledger entries once Platform lead signs off and Procurement pings vendor for duplicate/credit risk.

violet_ops: Proposed command: `./bin/bill-realloc --input gs://billing-backfills/2024-08-research-temp-untagged.csv --mapping policy-aug-2024.json --apply --note "retro split per Aug policy"` I will snapshot ledger before applying.

billing-bot: Billing service: reprocess job queued (#9951) by violet_ops. ETA 25m. Output to gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-08-realloc-9951.csv.

procurement-bot: Notified procurement team. Created vendor ticket for potential duplicate usage with CloudZ (ticket CZ-1145). Procurement will follow up and request invoice validation.

owen_platform: Platform lead DMed verbal approval for 55/35/10. I'll post confirmation here. Also adding a short-term data transform in `ingest/transforms/label_backfill.py` so future reingests map old `research-temp` rows to the new split. PR forthcoming.

billing-bot: Job #9951 completed. Summary: 26 instances adjusted, total reallocated = $15,760.00. Output: gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-08-realloc-9951.csv.

sam_fin: Opening ledger PR with before/after rows and audit note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/402. Tagging @meera_search and @owen_platform for sign-off. Including cost centers PLATFORM-CORE, SEARCH-TEAM, INFRA-OPS.

meera_search: Reviewed PR comments. Product sign-off given in PR. Confirmed no customer-facing credits.

owen_platform: PR looks good. I added ingest PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/899 which contains the backfill transform and unit tests.

procurement-bot: Procurement update: CloudZ acknowledged ticket CZ-1145 and will validate raw usage logs. ETA 3 business days for any vendor-side adjustment. Procurement will notify finance if CloudZ issues a credit.

sam_fin: Finance approved posting provisional ledger entries and will monitor for vendor credit. Adding note to monthly finance digest.

billing-bot: Ledger PR merged (#402). Accounting entries posted as `provisional_internal`. Thread closed unless procurement reports vendor credit. :white_check_mark:
